task: T04 upstream automatic-tiler baseline (Polonium vs Plastile)
layer: nested KWin virtual backend (not physical); kglobalaccel D-Bus command API, not input
labels: latency/churn/fights/geometry are MEASURED in nested KWin (virtual backend) from independent sources (harness send clock, fixture xdg configure logs, one-shot KWin oracle scripts). Attribution of Polonium swap latency to its RebuildDelay timer is MEASURED by the control run and matches OBSERVED SOURCE (src/controller/config.ts RebuildDelay default 10; controller eventTimer). No physical-session, presentation or input-to-photon claim is made.

metrics.sendToFirstConfigureNs: invokeShortcut send (CLOCK_MONOTONIC) -> first fixture xdg configure t_ns (CLOCK_MONOTONIC) within [t_send, t_next_send); later replies are censored into the next command at short spacing
metrics.sendToFirstSizeConfigureNs: same, first configure whose size differs from that fixture's previous one
metrics.configuresPerCommand: fixture configure records in [t_send, t_next_send) over all 3 fixtures
metrics.idleConfiguresAfter1s: configures >= 1 s after the last command of a phase (geometry fights)
metrics.oracleErrors: tests/integration/harness.tiling_errors on one-shot KWin script frames (no overlap, inside area)

verification.method: MEASURED: every file of the nightly package compared with the pin source; main.mjs rebuilt from the pin with npm ci --ignore-scripts (lockfile) + the Makefile's esbuild command in a separate directory
verification.metadataJson: equals res/metadata.json with the Makefile's %NAME%=polonium %VERSION%=1.2.2 substitution
